stem.text: The graph shows the variation of velocity with time for a stone that falls from a bridge into a lake and sinks to the bottom of the lake.

stem.alt: Graph of velocity against time with the printed labels velocity on the vertical axis, 0 at the origin and time on the horizontal axis. The curve rises, then falls steeply, then levels off as a horizontal line that ends in a vertical drop to the time axis.

stem.text: What can be deduced about the motion of the stone?

A.text: Terminal velocity was reached in air.

B.text: The acceleration in air was decreasing with increasing time.

C.text: The distance travelled in water was greater than the distance travelled in air.

D.text: The rate of change of velocity in air was constant.
